coverage.notes: Mapped reads occur before dispatch, but this indexed class has only ReadObjectAsJson, ReadObjectAsXml, DeleteFile and ListDirectoryObjects primitives. They take folder/fileName strings, no Plan. Mapped Invoke calls adapter.Invoke directly; no primitive bridge is present, so this is a dispatch mismatch, not supported concrete activity behavior or runtime acceptance.

All four mapped activities validate and dispatch locally. Address lookups are rooted in this.Signal, not Plan. VirtualPath may have been generated by mapped dispatch. Read fallback can clone the original Plan and invoke Write; those conditional helper reads are included. DEAD methods are excluded.

All four activities have concrete branches; null signals/Plan or missing addresses/path can return first. Helpers receive the same Plan. Addresses/Resource come from this; constructed REST plans and recursive other-adapter internals are excluded. Read SaveIfNew conditionally clones Plan and invokes Write.

Each requested mapped activity reaches shared Config reads, but concrete code replaces Activity with Config.VirtualPath segment 2 and handles only resulting Read. A mapped Read/Write/Delete/Exists does not establish corresponding concrete behavior. The REST clone receives generated Uri/Method/Host fields; other-adapter internals are not inventoried.
